title: Swap Two Variables
question: Swap the values of two variables without using a temporary variable.
code:
first = input("First value: ")
second = input("Second value: ")
first, second = second, first
print("First:", first)
print("Second:", second)
expected_output:
For inputs red and blue:
First value: red
Second value: blue
First: blue
Second: red
explanation: Python tuple unpacking lets you assign multiple values in one statement.
